item.text: *Oenanthe divaricata* is a flowering plant in the Apiaceae family, endemic to Portugal’s Madeira Archipelago. Authored by (R.Br.) Mabb. and published in 1980, it is protected under Annexes II and IV of the EU Habitats Directive. No common name is provided in the source. [s1:p1–p2, s1:p4–p7]
